title: docs(ui-adr): ADR-0057 Amendment A4 — an app's AI inquiry page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D3PqTGGb1rgoRqKj4rT4Xjk)_
Fixes #37819
Refs #37788
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：设计文档补一条修订：应用可以在菜单里放一个通用的 AI 问询页，放在第一位就是首页；在这一页上右上角的机器人隐藏。只改文档，用户无感。
- 为什么：这是「AI 问询首页」页面卡的前置；现有修订写的是「右侧抽屉是唯一的对话容器」，页面代码若先合，主干就和受管文档矛盾，所以文字先落。
- 出错会怎样：只动文档，不影响任何用户，写错了可直接撤回这次修改。
- 要你做的：无，座位交审批人。

## What changes

One file, `ui/docs/adr/0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md` (+90 / -0):

- New section `## Amendment A4 (2026-11-27, Accepted) — an app's AI inquiry page`, placed after Amendment A3 and before "Open design questions", in A3's shape: What it changes · Why · Maintainer ruling (verbatim, not translated, with where it is recorded and the time of each) · Decision · Consequences ("Implemented under objectstack#37788.").
- The Decision records the card's items 1–6 and nothing else: one `ai:chat` page per app (a `type: 'component'` navigation entry), copy from the entry's declared `params` (`AiChatNavParamsSchema` in `@objectstack/spec/ui`, objectstack#37787, merged), never from the URL, platform-generic, a key the entry omits falls back to neutral copy; the page is the app's home by the app's existing landing rule (a declared `AppSchema.landing` first; with none, from 768 px up the first entry shown lands; below 768 px the app root is the menu); on the page the drawer is closed and its triggers (top-bar robot, keyboard toggle) are hidden or inert, and no address stacks a second `ask` conversation there (the invariant of objectstack#37788 item 7, cited); the page runs `ask` (makers too), a build hand-off opens the drawer; conversation key `app:PKG:ask`, `?c=ID` restores, a foreign or other-app `?c=` opens the home state; A3 stands everywhere else. Named open, outside A4 and objectstack#37788: whether a phone's app root should open the page.
- A3's "One container" bullet gains one in-place pointer in A3's own style, `*(Amendment A4: …)*`, so a reader of A3 finds the exception.
- The header's **Amended** block gains one A4 entry after A3's (area o1-D's call on the round-1 open question): without it the header still said A3 made the drawer the ONLY chat container, contradicting the body.

Nothing decides beyond objectstack#37788's header and its items 1–8: no designer entry (T5), no hide-for-no-seat rule (T6); the Consequences say so in one sentence.

## Tests

Docs-only; no tests apply. The three ruling quotes were checked byte-for-byte against objectstack#37788's body: each occurs once there (inside the corner brackets) and once in the ADR as its own blockquote line.

## Acceptance notes

- `skip-changeset`: `ui/docs/adr/**` ships in no package (`ui/package.json` is private and no `ui/**/package.json` lists `docs`), so nothing publishes.
- Governed surface (`ui/docs/adr/**`, Tier H): this PR stays draft and is landed by neither the author nor the area; it goes to seat repo:objectstack#1 for the hand-off.
- Beyond the card's "No other section changes", one header entry (three lines) was added on area o1-D's answer (option B): the **Amended** block names A4. Open design questions are untouched.
- No ADR index row: the only index generator (`scripts/adr-index.mjs`) derives the ui-0057 row from title, status and date, which are unchanged.

## Verification

Read first:
1. The new `## Amendment A4` section (risk: the Decision saying more than the card's items 1–6).
2. The pointer added under A3's "One container" bullet.
3. The A4 entry in the header's **Amended** block.

Two-minute check: `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- ui/docs/adr/0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md` shows the A4 entry in the header's **Amended** block, one pointer inside A3's "One container" bullet and one new A4 section between A3's Consequences and "Open design questions", with nothing removed (+90 / -0). Round 3 answered L1-a's REWORK 7211260420 (S1, S2, N1, N2, N4 of record 7211253615); the sentence-by-sentence list is in the dev's delta report on #37819 (comment 7211453346).
